note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

parser.reason: Rust: rs/Cargo.toml lists `tabnas` (package tabnas-parser) under [dependencies], but nothing in rs/src or rs/benches uses the crate; its only use is `tabnas::Value` in the test rs/tests/json_readback.rs, so a test-only dependency is declared as a runtime one. Go: the only tabnas module the non-test .go files under go/ import is github.com/tabnas/transduce/go; go/readback_test.go is the one file that imports github.com/tabnas/parser/go, which go/go.mod requires. TypeScript: the only tabnas package ts/src imports is '@tabnas/transduce'; @tabnas/parser is a devDependency, imported by ts/test/json-readback.test.ts, and its peer was removed from ts/package.json on 2026-10-04 (tabnas/render#12).
parser.repair: rs/Cargo.toml would move `tabnas` from [dependencies] to [dev-dependencies]; then no port has the engine at run time and this entry is deleted. The other direction, adding the engine to the TypeScript and Go ports, has no source to support it, since neither imports it outside tests. "Decisions waiting on the maintainer", item 2, of the handover page in tabnas/parser (doc/handover/README.md) already asks whether to make this move. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
